title: Partition Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the partition function z for the system.

title: Entropy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the entropy sigma.

title: Average Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct formula for the average energy U.

title: Average Magnetic Moment
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the average magnetic moment M correctly.

title: Magnetic Moment Fluctuation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the fluctuation in the magnetic moment Delta M.

title: Thermal Equilibrium Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the implications of the change in magnetic field on the system's temperature.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all quantities are expressed with correct units.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for energy and magnetic moment.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit factors such as k or N in their final answers.
